trigger_phrase_or_event: Creator corrected the progression and asked to fix using the new agentic flow.
why_it_wins: It preserves the ordinary daily-human progression: dinner, first instinct, tiny lazy idea, silent handoff, deadpan read, plate-stack reversal, phone, and silent kitchen consequence.

agents.summary: Use a short-film/storybook sequence, not a quote carousel or meme-poster system.
Every slide has a behavior receipt: nearly finished plates, kitchen glance, pause, handoff, deadpan stare, stack, phone, kitchen walk.
The relationship is shown through timing and comfort. No one becomes saint, villain, servant, or lecturer.
Text must be tiny and in-scene. Native 4:5 proof is required before any batch because previous story-correct proof was too tall.
Every proof/final prompt must use identity_images/aachu_zuv.png and the identity contact sheet as actual visual references.
Generate slide 6 first. If plate stack, phone beat, exact line, 4:5 aspect, house style, and identity do not hold, repair before batch generation.

rejected_visual_patterns: wife service or chore fairness discourse
proof_requirement: Use v5 as story/action anchor, proof v4 and Main Kar Lungi slide 01 as style/aspect anchors, and identity_images/aachu_zuv.png as identity anchor.
